children.label: impact_evaluation
children.description: Assesses the long-term effects and outcomes of humanitarian interventions on the target population, often focusing on changes in well-being, health, or economic status.

children.label: process_evaluation
children.description: Examines the implementation and delivery of humanitarian programs, focusing on the processes, activities, and mechanisms that contribute to the program's success or failure.
example_papers: Evaluation of the Government of  Seychelles & United Nations  Strategic Partnership Framework (SPF) 2019-2023

children.label: formative_evaluation
children.description: Conducted during the early stages of a humanitarian intervention to improve the design and implementation of the program, often through feedback and iterative adjustments.
example_papers: Mid-term evaluation of the project "Upscaling climate resilience measures in the Dry Corridor agroecosystems of El Salvador (RECLIMA)"

children.label: real_time_evaluation
children.description: Involves ongoing assessment and feedback during the implementation of a humanitarian response, allowing for immediate adjustments and improvements to the intervention.

children.label: cost_effectiveness_analysis
children.description: Evaluates the cost and benefits of humanitarian interventions to determine the most efficient use of resources, often comparing different programs or strategies to identify the best value for money.
